meta.name: SwarmAI Dark Factory (Nightshift) — business-case assumptions
meta.reference_customer: Contoso Industrial Group (fictional) — discrete manufacturer (auto & industrial components), US$2.0B revenue, 8 plants, ~3,200 monitored assets, three-shift operation
meta.scenario_rule: Base uses `base` for every assumption. Conservative and Upside change ONLY the assumptions that carry a `scenario` object (the scenario drivers: value levers, benefit ramp, go-live timing, cost items, Azure usage drivers, and the expansion levers' adoption, start lag and ramp); every other assumption keeps its base value in all scenarios. `low`/`high` are the one-at-a-time stress ranges used by the sensitivity tornado (and by the live calculator's slider bounds). `bias` documents which direction is favourable to the customer and is not used in calculations. Azure usage drivers move with the scenario (Conservative = lower usage = lower ACR), so Conservative never inflates ACR. The five expansion levers (E1-E5, `exp_*`) are OFF (adoption 0) in Base and Conservative and ON in Upside; the `expansion` output block always shows the levers at their Upside adoption on top of the chosen scenario.

flags.given: stated in the product brief for the reference customer
flags.sourced: anchored on a cited source (see sources)
flags.assumption: Nightshift assumption — validate with customer data before committing
flags.price: Azure Retail Prices API list price (see prices and prices/prices-snapshot.json)

price_basis.basis: List price, pay-as-you-go (type=Consumption), no EA/CSP discount, no reservation or savings plan; swedencentral unless the meter is global/zone-based (IoT Operations, Device Registry, Private Link: Global; ExpressRoute circuit and Front Door: Zone 1) or not offered in swedencentral (Azure Digital Twins: westeurope)
price_basis.refresh: python prices/fetch_prices.py snapshot --queries prices/queries.json --out prices/prices-snapshot.json, then copy the unit prices into the prices block below (a unit test checks they agree)

SIEMENS_TCOD_2024.title: The True Cost of Downtime 2024
SIEMENS_TCOD_2024.facts: Average large plant loses 27 h/month = 326 h/year to unplanned downtime (down from 39 h/month in 2019); 25 incidents/month; cost per downtime hour from US$36,000 (FMCG) to US$2.3M (automotive); Fortune Global 500 lose ~US$1.4T a year = 11% of revenue

MCKINSEY_2017.title: Manufacturing: Analytics unleashes productivity and profitability
MCKINSEY_2017.facts: Predictive maintenance typically reduces machine downtime by 30 to 50 percent and increases machine life by 20 to 40 percent

OEE_COM.title: World-Class OEE: Set Targets To Drive Improvement
OEE_COM.facts: World-class OEE is 85%; most manufacturers are closer to 60%

WEF_GLN_2025.publisher: World Economic Forum with McKinsey & Company
WEF_GLN_2025.title: Global Lighthouse Network: The Mindset Shifts Driving Impact and Scale in Digital Transformation
WEF_GLN_2025.facts: 189 Lighthouse sites; step-changes averaging >50% in conversion cost, cycle time and defect rates; ROI multiples of two to three times in 10-20 months (leading sites, not typical plants)

EUROSTAT_MFG_2022.title: Businesses in the manufacturing sector (Statistics Explained), data year 2022
EUROSTAT_MFG_2022.facts: EU manufacturing: ~2.2M enterprises, ~30.0M persons employed; large enterprises (250+) employ 48.3% of manufacturing employment and generate 66.0% of value added (2022)

AZURE_RETAIL_PRICES.title: Azure Retail Prices API
AZURE_RETAIL_PRICES.facts: Public list-price API; queried 2026-11-17 (see prices block and prices/queries.json)

AZURE_IOT_OPS_LICENSING.title: Azure IoT Operations versions, support, and licensing
AZURE_IOT_OPS_LICENSING.facts: Essentials and Standard SKUs; OPC UA connector only in Standard; billed per Kubernetes node; Arc-connect regions include West Europe, North Europe, Germany West Central

SENTINEL_BILLING.title: Plan costs and understand Microsoft Sentinel pricing and billing
SENTINEL_BILLING.facts: Simplified pay-as-you-go analysis meter combines Log Analytics ingestion and Sentinel analysis

FABRIC_EVENTHOUSE_COST.title: Cost breakdown of Eventhouse
FABRIC_EVENTHOUSE_COST.facts: Worked examples of Eventhouse CU-hours per day at 1 TB and 2.5 TB/day ingestion

POWERBI_PRICING.title: Power BI pricing
POWERBI_PRICING.facts: Power BI Pro US$14.00 per user per month, paid yearly; Premium Per User US$24.00 (retrieved 2026-11-17). A Microsoft 365 licence, not Azure consumption

DEFENDER_IOT_BILLING.title: Microsoft Defender for IoT billing
DEFENDER_IOT_BILLING.facts: OT monitoring is billed with site-based licences by site size, purchased through the Microsoft 365 admin center; there is no Azure meter and no list price on the page (retrieved 2026-11-17)

SOPHOS_MFG_2024.title: The State of Ransomware in Manufacturing and Production 2024
SOPHOS_MFG_2024.facts: 65% of manufacturing and production organisations reported being hit by ransomware in the previous year (56% in 2023, 55% in 2022); 74% of attacks resulted in data encryption

plants_total.label: Plants in scope at full roll-out
plants_total.source: Brief: Contoso Industrial Group has 8 plants
plants_total.rationale: Reference customer. Change with the plants slider; set revenue_usd consistently (revenue is enterprise-wide, divided across plants).

plants_cum_share_by_year.label: Cumulative share of plants live by end of each year
plants_cum_share_by_year.source: Brief: 2 plants in Year 1, 5 in Year 2, 8 in Year 3 (= 0.25, 0.625, 1.0 of 8)
plants_cum_share_by_year.rationale: Base follows the brief. Conservative rolls out more slowly (1, 4, 7 plants); Upside faster (2, 6, 8).

go_live_month_in_year.label: Go-live month of each cohort within its onboarding year (1-12)
go_live_month_in_year.rationale: Cohorts go live mid-year, so a plant earns about half a year of ramped benefit in its onboarding year. Conservative = later go-live.

revenue_usd.label: Enterprise revenue
revenue_usd.rationale: Per-plant revenue = revenue_usd / plants_total; most baseline cost pools are expressed as % of plant revenue.

assets_per_plant.label: Monitored assets per plant
assets_per_plant.source: Brief: ~3,200 monitored assets across 8 plants = 400 per plant
assets_per_plant.rationale: Drives data volume, edge sizing and Azure usage (scaled linearly against reference_assets_per_plant).

lines_per_plant.label: Production lines per plant
lines_per_plant.rationale: Used to convert plant downtime into line-hours.

scheduled_hours_per_line_year.label: Scheduled production hours per line per year
scheduled_hours_per_line_year.source: Assumption: three shifts, ~5 days/week less holidays and planned stops
scheduled_hours_per_line_year.rationale: Basis for the downtime baseline (326 h/year is 5.4% of 6,000 h).

discount_rate.label: Discount rate (WACC)
discount_rate.rationale: Typical industrial WACC 8-12%. Conservative = higher rate.

baseline_unplanned_downtime_pct.label: Baseline unplanned downtime (% of scheduled line time)
baseline_unplanned_downtime_pct.source: SIEMENS_TCOD_2024: average large plant loses 326 h/year; 326 / 6,000 scheduled h = 5.4%
baseline_unplanned_downtime_pct.rationale: Siemens' figure is per plant of the Fortune-Global-500 sample; Contoso is smaller, so a range of 4-7% is used. Validate with the CMMS downtime log.

downtime_reduction_pct.label: Reduction of unplanned downtime hours
downtime_reduction_pct.source: MCKINSEY_2017: predictive maintenance typically cuts downtime 30-50%; haircut to 10-30% (base 20%)
downtime_reduction_pct.rationale: Conservative haircut because (a) benefits are measured against a baseline that already includes some PdM (Siemens: almost half of firms run PdM teams) and (b) autonomy ramps up gradually. To be measured by A/B replay and a pilot.

downtime_cost_pct_of_line_revenue.label: Cost of an unplanned line-hour as % of line revenue per hour
downtime_cost_pct_of_line_revenue.source: Assumption: lost contribution margin + idle labour + recovery/expedite
downtime_cost_pct_of_line_revenue.rationale: With US$250M plants and 5 lines this is about US$4.2k per line-hour, ~12% of the lowest sector figure in SIEMENS_TCOD_2024 (US$36k/h FMCG) and ~0.2% of the automotive figure (US$2.3M/h) - deliberately conservative for smaller plants. Used only if downtime_cost_per_line_hour_usd is null.

downtime_cost_per_line_hour_usd.label: Cost of one unplanned line-hour (absolute override)
downtime_cost_per_line_hour_usd.source: Calculator override; null = derive from revenue
downtime_cost_per_line_hour_usd.rationale: Set this in the live calculator to replace the derived value with the customer's own cost per downtime hour.

maintenance_spend_pct_revenue.label: Maintenance spend (% of plant revenue)
maintenance_spend_pct_revenue.rationale: Labour, spares, contractors and emergency repairs; validate with the maintenance budget.

maintenance_cost_reduction_pct.label: Reduction of maintenance spend
maintenance_cost_reduction_pct.source: Assumption (predictive vs. reactive/preventive mix; McKinsey and others report larger effects at mature sites)
maintenance_cost_reduction_pct.rationale: Fewer emergency repairs, overtime and expedited spares; planned work moves into changeover windows.

baseline_oee_pct.label: Baseline OEE
baseline_oee_pct.source: OEE_COM: most manufacturers are closer to 60% (world-class 85%)
baseline_oee_pct.rationale: Used to turn OEE points into a capacity gain.

oee_performance_uplift_pts.label: OEE uplift from planning/changeover/speed (excl. availability & scrap)
oee_performance_uplift_pts.source: Assumption; leading sites report +12-17 OEE points in total (WEF_GLN_2025) incl. availability
oee_performance_uplift_pts.rationale: Only the performance component is counted here to avoid double counting with downtime and scrap.

demand_capture_pct.label: Share of unlocked capacity that is sold
demand_capture_pct.rationale: The remainder is valued as deferred capex (capex category).

scrap_rework_cost_pct_revenue.label: Scrap & rework cost (% of plant revenue)
scrap_rework_cost_pct_revenue.source: Assumption (internal failure cost only; total cost of quality is usually higher)

scrap_reduction_pct.label: Reduction of scrap & rework cost
scrap_reduction_pct.source: Assumption (leading sites report 30-60% fewer defects, WEF_GLN_2025)
scrap_reduction_pct.rationale: SPC-driven compensation, quarantine and vision inspection; to be measured in A/B replay.

energy_spend_pct_revenue.label: Energy spend (% of plant revenue)
energy_spend_pct_revenue.rationale: Electricity and gas for machining, molding, compressed air and cooling.

energy_saving_pct.label: Energy cost reduction
energy_saving_pct.rationale: Tariff- and carbon-aware load shifting, peak shaving, idle-state reduction.

indirect_labour_fte_per_plant.label: Indirect FTE in planning, supervision, QA, reporting, maintenance planning
indirect_labour_fte_per_plant.rationale: Roles whose time is partly consumed by manual re-planning, reporting and triage.

loaded_labour_rate_usd_per_hour.label: Fully loaded labour rate
loaded_labour_rate_usd_per_hour.rationale: Override in the calculator with the customer's rate.

productive_hours_per_fte_year.label: Productive hours per FTE per year

indirect_labour_productivity_gain_pct.label: Productivity gain on indirect labour
indirect_labour_productivity_gain_pct.rationale: Capacity released (redeployed or avoided hiring) - not headcount reduction; the AgentOps team that supervises the swarm is costed separately.

inventory_pct_revenue.label: WIP + finished-goods + safety-stock inventory (% of plant revenue)
inventory_pct_revenue.rationale: Validate with balance-sheet inventory by plant.

inventory_reduction_pct.label: Inventory reduction
inventory_reduction_pct.rationale: Better schedule adherence and material staging reduce buffer stock. The one-time cash release is a memo item and is NOT in NPV.

inventory_carrying_cost_pct.label: Inventory carrying-cost rate
inventory_carrying_cost_pct.rationale: Only the recurring carrying-cost saving is counted in NPV.

expedite_spend_pct_revenue.label: Expedite & premium-freight spend (% of plant revenue)

expedite_reduction_pct.label: Reduction of expedite spend
expedite_reduction_pct.rationale: Materials agent detects supplier delay early and mitigates before premium freight is needed.

late_delivery_cost_pct_revenue.label: Cost of late/short deliveries (% of plant revenue)
late_delivery_cost_pct_revenue.source: Assumption (penalties, chargebacks, credits, lost orders at margin)

late_delivery_reduction_pct.label: Reduction of late/short-delivery cost
late_delivery_reduction_pct.rationale: Continuous re-planning protects due dates (tardiness is measured in A/B replay).

gross_ppe_pct_revenue.label: Gross plant & equipment (% of plant revenue)
gross_ppe_pct_revenue.rationale: Asset intensity used for capex deferral.

capex_carry_cost_pct.label: Annual carrying cost of deferred capex
capex_carry_cost_pct.rationale: Time value of not having to buy capacity.

conf_downtime.label: Confidence factor: downtime
conf_downtime.rationale: Directly measurable in CMMS; strongest evidence base.

conf_throughput.label: Confidence factor: throughput / OEE
conf_throughput.rationale: Depends on demand to sell the extra output.

conf_inventory.label: Confidence factor: inventory
conf_inventory.rationale: Requires supply-chain policy changes beyond the plant.

conf_capex.label: Confidence factor: capex deferral
conf_capex.rationale: Only real if capacity additions were planned.

benefit_ramp.label: Benefit realisation by year since go-live (year 1, 2, 3+)
benefit_ramp.source: Assumption: autonomy is earned decision class by decision class (L1 to L4)
benefit_ramp.rationale: Applied per cohort to the 12-month periods after that cohort's go-live month.

usage_ramp.label: Azure usage ramp by year since go-live (year 1, 2, 3+)
usage_ramp.rationale: Applies to usage-driven meters (tokens, ingestion, queries, logs). Provisioned capacity (nodes, circuits, baseline compute, Fabric CU) is billed in full from go-live.

edge_servers_per_plant.label: Edge servers per plant (HA Arc-enabled cluster)
edge_servers_per_plant.rationale: Three-node K3s / AKS-on-Azure-Local class cluster for IoT Operations, local inference and edge-resident Safety Sentinel.

edge_server_cost_usd.label: Cost per industrial edge server
edge_server_cost_usd.source: Assumption (street price class for ruggedised edge servers)

ot_network_security_hw_usd_per_plant.label: OT DMZ switches/firewalls per plant
ot_network_security_hw_usd_per_plant.rationale: Segmentation per IEC 62443 zones and conduits.

sensor_retrofit_share_of_assets.label: Share of assets needing added sensors
sensor_retrofit_share_of_assets.rationale: Vibration/temperature/current sensors on critical assets without native data.

legacy_gateways_per_plant.label: Protocol gateways for legacy PLCs per plant

readiness_assessment_usd.label: Lights-Out Readiness Assessment (paid, partner-delivered)
readiness_assessment_usd.rationale: Land motion; may be discounted or credited against the pilot in practice.

platform_foundation_integration_usd.label: Platform foundation (landing zone, UNS design, templates, security review)
platform_foundation_integration_usd.rationale: Done once for the enterprise; reused by every plant.

integration_first_plants_count.label: Number of plants at the higher (first-of-a-kind) integration cost
integration_first_plants_count.rationale: Learning curve: later plants reuse connector and policy templates.

integration_per_plant_first_usd.label: Integration & onboarding per early plant
integration_per_plant_first_usd.rationale: MES/SCADA/ERP/CMMS connectors, asset modelling, twin calibration, policy authoring, commissioning.

change_mgmt_per_plant_usd.label: Change management & training per plant
change_mgmt_per_plant_usd.rationale: Operator, maintenance and supervisor training; autonomy-dial workshops.

agentops_fte_central.label: Central AgentOps / policy-governance FTE
agentops_fte_central.rationale: The humans on the loop: policy owners, model/agent operations, ledger audit.

agentops_fte_per_plant.label: AgentOps FTE per live plant
agentops_fte_per_plant.rationale: Remote-operator exception handling is largely absorbed by existing shift supervisors.

platform_licence_per_plant_usd_year.label: SwarmAI platform subscription per live plant
platform_licence_per_plant_usd_year.source: Assumption: pricing hint (~US$400 per monitored asset per year); no public price
platform_licence_per_plant_usd_year.rationale: Excludes Azure consumption (billed by Microsoft). Roughly 4% of risk-adjusted benefit per plant at maturity.

other_licences_per_plant_usd_year.label: Other licences per live plant (Defender for IoT OT site licence, Power BI, connectors)
other_licences_per_plant_usd_year.source: Assumption: Defender for IoT OT licences are bought per site via the Microsoft 365 admin center (not Azure consumption)

contingency_pct_one_time.label: Contingency on one-time costs
contingency_pct_one_time.rationale: Applied to hardware, integration, change management, foundation and assessment.

hardware_lead_months.label: Hardware purchased N months before go-live

integration_lead_months.label: Integration cost incurred N months before go-live

change_lead_months.label: Change-management cost incurred N months before go-live

provision_lead_months.label: Provisioned Azure/edge capacity billed N months before go-live

shared_platform_start_month.label: Month (0-based) in which the shared Azure platform and AgentOps team start
shared_platform_start_month.rationale: Landing zone after the readiness assessment.

azure_price_multiplier.label: Azure price multiplier (1.0 = list price)
azure_price_multiplier.source: List price by default (no EA discount); use e.g. 0.85 to test a 15% discount
azure_price_multiplier.rationale: Scales every meter; affects both customer Azure cost and ACR.

reference_assets_per_plant.label: Reference plant size for Azure sizing
reference_assets_per_plant.rationale: All per-plant Azure drivers below are stated for this plant and scaled linearly with assets_per_plant.

nonprod_environment_uplift_pct.label: Dev/test/staging uplift on cloud platform families
nonprod_environment_uplift_pct.rationale: Non-production environments (twin sandboxes, agent evaluation, model training).

dr_uplift_pct.label: Disaster-recovery uplift on cloud platform families
dr_uplift_pct.source: Assumption: warm-standby second region at a fraction of primary
dr_uplift_pct.rationale: Safety-critical loops stay at the edge, so cloud DR is warm-standby rather than active-active.

shared_scale_points.label: Shared platform scale vs. plants [[plants, scale]]
shared_scale_points.source: Assumption: enterprise components grow sub-linearly with plants
shared_scale_points.rationale: Linear interpolation between points; applies to quantity-driven shared items (Fabric base CU, shared compute, shared PEs, shared log/Sentinel volume).

pilot_shared_scale.label: Shared platform scale for a single-line pilot

pilot_assets.label: Assets in a single-line pilot
pilot_assets.rationale: Pilot tier for the ACR-by-tier view.

llm_usage_multiplier.label: LLM usage multiplier (scales all call volumes)
llm_usage_multiplier.rationale: Scenario lever for agent autonomy and copilot adoption.

llm_prompt_cache_hit_share.label: Share of input tokens served from the prompt cache
llm_prompt_cache_hit_share.rationale: Agents re-send policy and asset context.

llm_agent_calls_per_plant_day.label: Agent situation-assessment calls per plant-day (gpt-5.4-mini)
llm_agent_calls_per_plant_day.source: Assumption: 7 agents x 3 areas x 12 assessments/hour x 24 h = 6,048
llm_agent_calls_per_plant_day.rationale: Deterministic detectors run continuously; the LLM is called on a 5-minute cadence per agent and area to interpret context and draft proposals.

llm_agent_in_tokens.label: Input tokens per agent call
llm_agent_in_tokens.rationale: Policy, asset state, recent ledger context.

llm_reasoning_calls_per_plant_day.label: High-stakes reasoning calls per plant-day (gpt-5.4)
llm_reasoning_calls_per_plant_day.rationale: Conflict arbitration narratives, what-if interpretation, safety-relevant decisions.

llm_reasoning_out_tokens.label: Output (incl. reasoning) tokens per reasoning call
llm_reasoning_out_tokens.rationale: Reasoning tokens are billed as output.

llm_triage_calls_per_plant_day.label: Alarm/event triage calls per plant-day (gpt-5.4-nano)
llm_triage_calls_per_plant_day.rationale: Cheap classifier on alarm floods and work-order text.

llm_vision_calls_per_plant_day.label: Vision inspection escalations per plant-day (gpt-5.4-mini, multimodal)
llm_vision_calls_per_plant_day.source: Assumption: edge models handle first-line inspection; only low-confidence images go to the cloud model

llm_vision_in_tokens.label: Input tokens per image call (image + prompt)
llm_vision_in_tokens.rationale: No prompt caching assumed for image calls.

llm_digest_calls_per_plant_day.label: Shift digest / RCA narration calls per plant-day (gpt-5.4-mini)

embedding_tokens_per_plant_day.label: Embedding tokens per plant-day (RAG over SOPs, manuals, ledger)

ai_search_base_units.label: AI Search S1 units (shared, HA replicas)

ai_search_plants_per_extra_unit.label: Add one AI Search unit per N plants

aml_endpoint_instances_per_plant.label: Azure ML managed online endpoint instances per plant (D4s v5)
aml_endpoint_instances_per_plant.source: Assumption: cloud-side inference for models not run at the edge

aml_training_hours_per_plant_month.label: Azure ML training hours per plant-month (D16s v5)
aml_training_hours_per_plant_month.source: Assumption: weekly retraining of per-asset-class anomaly/RUL models with sweeps

aml_gpu_hours_per_plant_month.label: Azure ML GPU training hours per plant-month (NC8as T4 v3)

data_volume_multiplier.label: Telemetry volume multiplier
data_volume_multiplier.rationale: Scales tag counts / publish rates (richer sensing = more data).

tags_hot_per_asset.label: Hot tags per asset (published every hot_publish_interval_s)
tags_hot_per_asset.rationale: State, vibration RMS, temperature, current, spindle load, counters.

tags_warm_per_asset.label: Warm tags per asset (published every warm_publish_interval_s)

bytes_per_message.label: Bytes per telemetry message (batched, with metadata)

compression_ratio.label: Columnar compression ratio for stored telemetry

onelake_retention_months.label: OneLake / Eventhouse retention for curated telemetry

storage_hot_months.label: Months in the hot tier before moving to cool

storage_transactions_uplift_pct.label: Storage transaction charges as % of capacity charges
storage_transactions_uplift_pct.rationale: Transaction meters are not modelled individually.

waveform_assets_share.label: Share of assets with waveform capture
waveform_assets_share.rationale: High-frequency vibration snapshots for critical rotating assets.

waveform_snapshots_per_asset_day.label: Waveform snapshots per asset per day

other_blob_gb_per_plant.label: Other blob data per plant (models, ledger segments, backups)
other_blob_gb_per_plant.rationale: Ledger WORM segments, model artefacts, snapshots.

fabric_base_cu.label: Fabric shared base capacity (BI, governance, digital-twin builder, notebooks)

fabric_cu_per_plant.label: Fabric capacity per plant (Eventstream, Eventhouse, Activator, Spark ETL)
fabric_cu_per_plant.source: Assumption; calibrated against FABRIC_EVENTHOUSE_COST (817 CU-hours/day = ~34 CU for 2.5 TB/day of continuously queried data; a plant ingests ~10 GB/day raw)
fabric_cu_per_plant.rationale: Mostly processing, rules and BI rather than raw ingestion volume.

fabric_cu_granularity.label: Fabric capacity rounding granularity
fabric_cu_granularity.source: Modelled as a stack of F-SKUs
fabric_cu_granularity.rationale: PAYG capacity is billed per CU-hour, 24x7 for real-time workloads.

edge_nodes_per_plant.label: Arc-enabled Kubernetes nodes running IoT Operations per plant
edge_nodes_per_plant.source: Assumption; AZURE_IOT_OPS_LICENSING: billed per node; OPC UA connector requires the Standard SKU

edge_vcores_per_node.label: vCores per edge node (Defender for Containers)

devices_per_plant.label: Devices registered in Azure Device Registry per plant (PLCs, gateways, cells)
devices_per_plant.rationale: Assets are registered per monitored asset (assets_per_plant).

eventgrid_million_ops_per_plant_month.label: Event Grid operations per plant per month

adt_ops_per_asset_minute.label: Digital Twins operations per asset per minute (property updates)
adt_ops_per_asset_minute.rationale: State, health and KPI property patches.

adt_messages_per_asset_minute.label: Digital Twins routed messages per asset per minute

adt_queries_per_plant_minute.label: Digital Twins queries per plant per minute

cosmos_max_ru_per_plant.label: Cosmos DB autoscale max RU/s per plant
cosmos_max_ru_per_plant.source: Assumption: agent memory, blackboard, ledger index, KPI snapshots

cosmos_autoscale_avg_fraction.label: Average billed fraction of autoscale max
cosmos_autoscale_avg_fraction.source: Assumption (autoscale scales between 10% and 100% of max)

cosmos_regions.label: Cosmos DB regions (primary + DR replica)
cosmos_regions.rationale: Throughput, storage and Defender cost multiply by regions.

cosmos_gb_per_plant.label: Cosmos DB data per plant at steady state

compute_vcpu_per_plant.label: Always-on Container Apps (dedicated) vCPU per plant
compute_vcpu_per_plant.source: Assumption: agent runtimes, supervisor, APIs, what-if workers

compute_burst_vcpu_hours_per_plant_month.label: Burst vCPU-hours per plant-month (A/B replay, what-if forks, ETL)
compute_burst_vcpu_hours_per_plant_month.rationale: Container Apps consumption plan, active usage.

compute_enterprise_vcpu.label: Shared platform vCPU (hub APIs, control tower, fleet services, MCP tools)

er_circuits_per_plant.label: ExpressRoute 200 Mbps circuits per plant
er_circuits_per_plant.source: Assumption; the carrier's last-mile charge is not an Azure charge and is excluded

vpn_gateways_per_plant.label: VPN gateways (VpnGw1AZ) per plant as backup path

front_door_shared.label: Azure Front Door Premium profiles (shared)
front_door_shared.rationale: Base fee only; request/transfer charges are small for an internal control tower.

private_link_gb_per_plant_month.label: Data processed by Private Link per plant-month

defender_storage_accounts_per_plant.label: Storage accounts per plant protected by Defender for Storage

defender_storage_accounts_shared.label: Shared storage accounts protected by Defender for Storage

defender_subscriptions_shared.label: Subscriptions protected by Defender for Resource Manager

sentinel_gb_per_plant_day.label: Security log volume sent to Sentinel per plant-day
sentinel_gb_per_plant_day.source: Assumption; SENTINEL_BILLING: simplified pay-as-you-go meter covers ingestion + analysis
sentinel_gb_per_plant_day.rationale: OT network sensor logs, agent audit/decision events, identity and Defender signals.

sentinel_gb_shared_day.label: Shared security log volume (Entra, Azure activity, Defender XDR) per day

loganalytics_gb_per_plant_day.label: Application/infrastructure logs per plant-day
loganalytics_gb_per_plant_day.rationale: App Insights traces, container logs, edge pipeline logs.

loganalytics_retention_days.label: Log Analytics interactive retention
loganalytics_retention_days.source: Assumption (first 31 days included in ingestion price)

tam_eu_large_enterprise_employment_share.label: Share of EU manufacturing employment in large enterprises (250+)

tam_employees_per_large_plant.label: Average employees per plant of a large enterprise
tam_employees_per_large_plant.rationale: Turns employment into a plant count; low/high are inverted on purpose (more employees per plant = fewer plants).

tam_automation_ready_share.label: Share of large-enterprise plants that are discrete, connected and automation-ready
tam_automation_ready_share.source: Assumption: validate with Microsoft industry data
tam_automation_ready_share.rationale: Filters for discrete manufacturing with OPC UA-capable equipment.

tam_global_to_eu_multiplier.label: Global addressable plants as a multiple of the EU
tam_global_to_eu_multiplier.source: Assumption: validate with Microsoft industry data

tam_penetration_year5.label: Share of addressable plants live by year 5
tam_penetration_year5.rationale: Illustrative; not a forecast or commitment.

exp_benefit_ramp.label: Expansion levers: benefit realisation by year since the lever starts
exp_benefit_ramp.source: Assumption: levers start after the core platform is stable, so they ramp faster than the core (35/75/95)
exp_benefit_ramp.rationale: Applied per cohort to the 12-month periods after that cohort's lever start month.

exp_usage_ramp.label: Expansion levers: Azure usage by year since the lever starts
exp_usage_ramp.rationale: Usage-based lines (tokens, GPU hours, ingestion) ramp with the lever; provisioned capacity is billed in full from the provisioning lead time.

exp_fleet_plants.label: Plants in the illustrative enterprise-fleet tier (expansion case)
exp_fleet_plants.source: Assumption: large multi-site manufacturers run 50-250 plants
exp_fleet_plants.rationale: Used only for the fleet tier of the expansion view (steady-state run-rate at the Upside adoption of the five levers); the shared-platform scale factor is extrapolated linearly beyond 25 plants.

exp_vision_adoption.label: E1 Machine-vision fleet: share of live plants that deploy it
exp_vision_adoption.source: Assumption: OFF in Base and Conservative; ON in Upside. Set to 1 in the calculator to see the full-fleet case
exp_vision_adoption.rationale: Plants with inspection-heavy lines adopt first; equivalent to half of the reference camera footprint in every plant.

exp_vision_start_lag_months.label: E1: months after plant go-live before the vision fleet starts
exp_vision_start_lag_months.source: Assumption: starts after the shadow-mode evidence of the core platform

exp_vision_cameras_per_plant.label: E1: inspection cameras per plant
exp_vision_cameras_per_plant.source: Assumption: about 6 inline stations on each of 5 lines
exp_vision_cameras_per_plant.rationale: Edge inference is customer-side; this drives edge hardware and the volume of images the edge scores.

exp_vision_fps_per_camera.label: E1: frames scored per second per camera (inline inspection)
exp_vision_fps_per_camera.source: Assumption: one image per part, a part every 2 s
exp_vision_fps_per_camera.rationale: Scored at the edge; only a share is uploaded.

exp_vision_upload_share.label: E1: share of scored images uploaded to the Azure archive
exp_vision_upload_share.source: Assumption: defects and low-confidence images plus about 1% sampled good images for drift and retraining
exp_vision_upload_share.rationale: Archiving every image would multiply storage by 30.

exp_vision_image_mb.label: E1: size of an uploaded inspection image

exp_vision_retention_months.label: E1: retention of the defect and sample archive
exp_vision_retention_months.source: Assumption: automotive traceability can require 10-15 years; 36 months used
exp_vision_retention_months.rationale: Hot for the first storage_hot_months, then cool ZRS (archive-tier savings not assumed).

exp_vision_escalation_share.label: E1: share of scored images escalated to a cloud multimodal model
exp_vision_escalation_share.source: Assumption: low-confidence frames only; edge models handle the rest

exp_vision_escalation_gpt54_share.label: E1: share of escalations sent to the larger reasoning model
exp_vision_escalation_gpt54_share.source: Assumption: hard cases; the rest use gpt-5.4-mini

exp_vision_gpt54_in_tokens.label: E1: input tokens per hard-case call (image + defect library context)

exp_vision_gpt54_out_tokens.label: E1: output tokens per hard-case call

exp_vision_models_per_plant.label: E1: vision models maintained per plant
exp_vision_models_per_plant.source: Assumption: one per product family or station group

exp_vision_retrains_per_model_year.label: E1: retraining runs per model per year

exp_vision_gpu_hours_per_retrain.label: E1: T4 GPU hours per retraining run including back-testing on the archive

exp_vision_a100_hours_per_plant_month.label: E1: A100 GPU hours per plant-month for foundation-model fine-tuning

exp_vision_la_gb_per_plant_day.label: E1: pipeline telemetry ingested to Log Analytics per plant-day
exp_vision_la_gb_per_plant_day.source: Assumption: inference metrics, drift statistics, labelling-queue events

exp_vision_station_cost_usd.label: E1: cost of one camera station (camera, optics, lighting, enclosure, mount)
exp_vision_station_cost_usd.source: Assumption: validate with an integrator quote

exp_vision_edge_gpu_servers_per_plant.label: E1: edge GPU servers per plant

exp_vision_edge_gpu_server_cost_usd.label: E1: cost of an edge GPU server

exp_vision_integration_usd.label: E1: integration and initial model development per plant
exp_vision_integration_usd.rationale: Line integration, labelling of the initial dataset, model tuning.

exp_vision_change_usd.label: E1: change management and training per plant

exp_vision_licence_per_camera_usd_year.label: E1: vision software licence per camera per year

exp_vision_review_fte_per_plant.label: E1: human review and labelling FTE per plant (humans on the loop)

exp_vision_quality_cost_pct_revenue.label: E1: escape, containment and warranty cost beyond the core scrap baseline
exp_vision_quality_cost_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: validate with the quality ledger
exp_vision_quality_cost_pct_revenue.rationale: Reported in the scrap and rework category.

exp_vision_quality_reduction_pct.label: E1: reduction of that quality cost from earlier and more consistent detection
exp_vision_quality_reduction_pct.source: Assumption: validate in a station pilot

exp_vision_inspectors_per_plant.label: E1: manual visual inspectors per plant

exp_vision_inspection_labour_reduction_p.label: E1: share of manual inspection hours released (redeployed, not removed)
exp_vision_inspection_labour_reduction_p.rationale: Capacity released; depends on the customer's redeployment decision.

exp_vision_inspector_rate_usd_hour.label: E1: loaded cost of an inspector hour

exp_hf_adoption.label: E2 High-frequency condition monitoring: share of live plants that deploy it
exp_hf_adoption.source: Assumption: OFF in Base and Conservative; ON in Upside

exp_hf_start_lag_months.label: E2: months after plant go-live before kHz monitoring starts

exp_hf_rotating_assets_share.label: E2: share of assets that are rotating machinery with kHz sensors
exp_hf_rotating_assets_share.source: Assumption: motors, pumps, spindles, gearboxes, compressors

exp_hf_channels_per_asset.label: E2: vibration channels per monitored asset

exp_hf_duty_cycle.label: E2: share of time that raw waveforms are uploaded
exp_hf_duty_cycle.source: Assumption: about 30 s of every 10 min; 1.0 = continuous raw streaming
exp_hf_duty_cycle.rationale: The edge extracts features continuously; raw snapshots go to the cloud on a schedule and on trigger.

exp_hf_compression_ratio.label: E2: compression of raw waveforms before upload

exp_hf_event_kb.label: E2: payload of one Event Hubs event (waveform batch)
exp_hf_event_kb.rationale: Event Hubs Standard limit is 1 MB per event.

exp_hf_raw_retention_months.label: E2: retention of raw waveforms
exp_hf_raw_retention_months.rationale: Hot for the first storage_hot_months, then cool ZRS.

exp_hf_feature_gb_per_asset_day.label: E2: extracted features per monitored asset per day

exp_hf_feature_retention_months.label: E2: retention of extracted features in OneLake

exp_hf_fabric_cu_per_plant.label: E2: Fabric capacity per plant for feature extraction and Eventhouse queries
exp_hf_fabric_cu_per_plant.source: Assumption calibrated on the Eventhouse cost guidance (FABRIC_EVENTHOUSE_COST)

exp_hf_train_hours_per_plant_month.label: E2: CPU training hours per plant-month (D16s v5)

exp_hf_gpu_hours_per_plant_month.label: E2: GPU training hours per plant-month (T4)

exp_hf_endpoint_instances_per_plant.label: E2: managed online endpoint instances per plant (D4s v5)

exp_hf_la_gb_per_plant_day.label: E2: pipeline telemetry ingested to Log Analytics per plant-day

exp_hf_sensor_cost_per_asset_usd.label: E2: installed cost of kHz sensors and data acquisition per asset

exp_hf_integration_usd.label: E2: integration and failure-signature work per plant

exp_hf_change_usd.label: E2: change management and training per plant

exp_hf_licence_per_asset_usd_year.label: E2: analytics licence per monitored asset per year

exp_hf_review_fte_per_plant.label: E2: reliability-engineer review time per plant

exp_hf_extra_downtime_reduction_pct.label: E2: additional unplanned-downtime reduction beyond the core (share of baseline downtime hours)
exp_hf_extra_downtime_reduction_pct.source: Assumption: core 20% + 5 points = 25%, inside the 30-50% literature range (MCKINSEY_2017)
exp_hf_extra_downtime_reduction_pct.rationale: Earlier detection of bearing and gear faults from kHz data.

exp_hf_extra_maintenance_reduction_pct.label: E2: additional maintenance-spend reduction (planned instead of emergency work)

exp_sim_adoption.label: E3 Continuous sim-first what-if at scale: share of live plants that deploy it
exp_sim_adoption.source: Assumption: OFF in Base and Conservative; ON in Upside
exp_sim_adoption.rationale: Plants that earn L4/L5 on some decision classes.

exp_sim_start_lag_months.label: E3: months after plant go-live before continuous what-if starts
exp_sim_start_lag_months.source: Assumption: needs 8+ weeks of shadow evidence per decision class

exp_sim_decisions_per_plant_day.label: E3: decisions per plant-day that are rehearsed on the twin
exp_sim_decisions_per_plant_day.source: Assumption: every consequential proposal plus periodic re-planning

exp_sim_rollouts_per_decision.label: E3: Monte-Carlo rollouts per decision
exp_sim_rollouts_per_decision.source: Assumption: uncertainty-aware what-if instead of a single deterministic run

exp_sim_vcpu_seconds_per_rollout.label: E3: vCPU-seconds per rollout (24 h horizon, 400-asset plant)
exp_sim_vcpu_seconds_per_rollout.source: Assumption: discrete-event simulation with physics-lite models
exp_sim_vcpu_seconds_per_rollout.rationale: Discrete-event simulation is cheap; physics-level fidelity multiplies it.

exp_sim_node_utilisation.label: E3: average utilisation of the simulation node pools
exp_sim_node_utilisation.source: Assumption: autoscaled pool, pay-as-you-go list price (no spot or reservation discount)
exp_sim_node_utilisation.rationale: Billed as D16s v5 VM-hours (AKS / Batch); Container Apps jobs would cost more per vCPU-hour.

exp_sim_result_gb_per_plant_day.label: E3: simulation results and rollout logs per plant-day

exp_sim_cosmos_max_ru.label: E3: additional Cosmos DB autoscale RU/s for twin snapshots and the scenario cache

exp_sim_la_gb_per_plant_day.label: E3: telemetry ingested to Log Analytics per plant-day

exp_sim_integration_usd.label: E3: twin calibration and policy tuning per plant

exp_sim_change_usd.label: E3: change management and training per plant

exp_sim_agentops_fte_per_plant.label: E3: additional AgentOps FTE per plant (policy owners, ledger audit)

exp_sim_extra_labour_gain_pct.label: E3: additional indirect-labour productivity from higher autonomy levels

exp_sim_extra_energy_saving_pct.label: E3: additional energy-cost saving from safer, more aggressive load shifting

exp_sim_extra_oee_pts.label: E3: additional OEE performance uplift (points)
exp_sim_extra_oee_pts.rationale: Converted like the core uplift: demand_capture_pct sold at the contribution margin.

exp_dp_adoption.label: E4 Enterprise data-platform modernisation: share of live plants migrated
exp_dp_adoption.source: Assumption: OFF in Base and Conservative; ON in Upside (platform decision, so all plants)

exp_dp_start_lag_months.label: E4: months after plant go-live before its historian is migrated

exp_dp_fabric_cu_per_plant.label: E4: additional Fabric capacity per migrated plant (back-fill, ETL, semantic models)
exp_dp_fabric_cu_per_plant.source: Assumption; capacity is billed per CU-hour at list price (reservations not assumed)
exp_dp_fabric_cu_per_plant.rationale: Power BI viewers do not need Pro licences on F64 or larger capacities; creators do (customer cost, not ACR).

exp_dp_fabric_cu_enterprise.label: E4: enterprise analytics capacity at the reference platform size (cross-plant models, thousands of report users)
exp_dp_fabric_cu_enterprise.rationale: Scaled by the shared-platform scale factor, like the core Fabric base.

exp_dp_onelake_retention_months.label: E4: retention of curated telemetry in OneLake
exp_dp_onelake_retention_months.source: Assumption: 7-10 years for quality and warranty analytics
exp_dp_onelake_retention_months.rationale: The core model retains 24 months; E4 pays for the extension.

exp_dp_historian_tb_per_plant.label: E4: migrated historian archive per plant
exp_dp_historian_tb_per_plant.source: Assumption: about 10 years of compressed history

exp_dp_la_gb_per_plant_day.label: E4: pipeline telemetry ingested to Log Analytics per plant-day

exp_dp_migration_per_plant_usd.label: E4: historian and OT data-lake migration per plant (incl. 12-month parallel run)

exp_dp_programme_enterprise_usd.label: E4: enterprise data-platform programme (design, governance, BI migration), one-time
exp_dp_programme_enterprise_usd.rationale: Incurred when the first plant migrates.

exp_dp_change_per_plant_usd.label: E4: change management and training per plant

exp_dp_bi_creators.label: E4: Power BI report creators (Pro licences)
exp_dp_bi_creators.source: Assumption: creators need Pro; viewers are free on F64+ capacity
exp_dp_bi_creators.rationale: Customer cost through Microsoft 365, not Azure consumption.

exp_dp_bi_pro_usd_month.label: E4: Power BI Pro list price
exp_dp_bi_pro_usd_month.rationale: US$14.00 per user per month, paid yearly (retrieved 2026-11-17).

exp_dp_data_eng_fte_per_plant.label: E4: data-engineering FTE per migrated plant

exp_dp_avoided_historian_usd_per_plant_y.label: E4: avoided historian licences, servers and support per plant per year
exp_dp_avoided_historian_usd_per_plant_y.source: Assumption: validate with the customer's licence and infrastructure ledger
exp_dp_avoided_historian_usd_per_plant_y.rationale: Reported in the data-platform and IT savings category.

exp_dp_avoided_bi_usd_per_plant_year.label: E4: avoided legacy BI and reporting tools per plant per year

exp_dp_analytics_hours_saved_per_plant_y.label: E4: analyst and engineer hours saved on data collection and cleaning per plant per year

exp_dp_analyst_rate_usd_hour.label: E4: loaded cost of an analyst hour

exp_dp_conf.label: E4: confidence factor, data-platform and IT savings
exp_dp_conf.rationale: Avoided licences depend on contract terms and cut-over dates.

exp_sec_adoption.label: E5 OT security and connectivity hardening: share of live plants hardened
exp_sec_adoption.source: Assumption: OFF in Base and Conservative; ON in Upside (policy decision, so all plants)

exp_sec_start_lag_months.label: E5: months after plant go-live before hardening starts

exp_sec_er_circuits_per_plant.label: E5: additional diverse ExpressRoute circuits per plant (1 Gbps metered)
exp_sec_er_circuits_per_plant.source: Assumption: second path with a different provider; the core already has one circuit and a VPN backup

exp_sec_er_gb_out_per_plant_month.label: E5: data from Azure to the plant over ExpressRoute per month (metered)
exp_sec_er_gb_out_per_plant_month.source: Assumption: model and image updates, policy bundles, remote sessions

exp_sec_fw_gb_per_plant_month.label: E5: traffic inspected by Azure Firewall Premium per plant-month

exp_sec_plants_per_hub.label: E5: plants served by one regional hub firewall
exp_sec_plants_per_hub.source: Assumption: one Firewall Premium deployment per regional hub

exp_sec_servers_per_plant.label: E5: OT servers per plant protected by Defender for Servers P2 (Arc-enabled)
exp_sec_servers_per_plant.source: Assumption: historian, HMI, engineering and jump servers

exp_sec_sentinel_gb_per_plant_day.label: E5: OT security logs ingested to Microsoft Sentinel per plant-day
exp_sec_sentinel_gb_per_plant_day.source: Assumption: firewall, server, identity and OT-sensor alert logs; priced at the Sentinel pay-as-you-go meter (SENTINEL_BILLING)

exp_sec_la_gb_per_plant_day.label: E5: additional Log Analytics ingestion per plant-day (network flow, diagnostics)

exp_sec_sensors_per_plant.label: E5: OT network-monitoring sensors per plant (Defender for IoT)

exp_sec_sensor_cost_usd.label: E5: cost of one OT network sensor appliance

exp_sec_integration_usd.label: E5: zone and conduit design, segmentation and onboarding per plant

exp_sec_change_usd.label: E5: change management and training per plant

exp_sec_ot_site_licence_usd_year.label: E5: Defender for IoT OT-monitoring site licence per plant per year
exp_sec_ot_site_licence_usd_year.source: DEFENDER_IOT_BILLING: site-based licences bought through Microsoft 365; no list price in the Retail Prices API, so this is an assumption
exp_sec_ot_site_licence_usd_year.rationale: Customer cost, not Azure consumption (excluded from ACR).

exp_sec_soc_fte_per_plant.label: E5: additional security-operations FTE per plant

exp_sec_incident_prob_per_plant_year.label: E5: annual probability of a disruptive cyber incident per plant
exp_sec_incident_prob_per_plant_year.source: Assumption informed by SOPHOS_MFG_2024 (65% of manufacturers hit by ransomware in 2023, per organisation)
exp_sec_incident_prob_per_plant_year.rationale: Per plant and per year, below the per-organisation survey rate.

exp_sec_incident_cost_usd.label: E5: cost of a disruptive incident at one plant (outage, recovery, response)
exp_sec_incident_cost_usd.source: Assumption: 5-7 days of lost contribution (about US$190k a day at the reference plant) plus recovery and response

exp_sec_risk_reduction_pct.label: E5: reduction of expected incident loss from hardening and monitoring

exp_sec_insurance_premium_usd_per_plant.label: E5: cyber-insurance premium per plant per year

exp_sec_premium_reduction_pct.label: E5: premium reduction earned by the controls

exp_sec_conf.label: E5: confidence factor, cyber-risk benefit
exp_sec_conf.source: Assumption: expected-loss estimates are uncertain; this is mainly a risk and compliance lever
